title: The Word Held at the Teeth

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A breath held at the iron is spent whether it goes in or not. A word held at the teeth is kept, and a kept thing is owed.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the clay-bound, Low Kiln

where: Low Kiln and the Weir, Sill
pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a one-hundred-and-twenty-three-to-one-hundred-and-twenty-five-day-old body carried everywhere; the surgeon's register colours the noticing (a field gone around read as a chart closed over an unopened note, a breath stopped at the top of a reach read as a breath held against a clamp, a stopped sentence read as an interval on a tray, a cord carried inside a coat read as a record kept where no thumb will read it) without a present-tense Chicago break or a tagged remembered line --- the old life stays offstage --- and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, Waiting Room, collector or back-room interior

scenes.title: A Direction in the Beds
scenes.synopsis: First entry and first \daymark of Day 123, Reed 4, Fourthday, morning at the yard at Low Kiln and the edge of the worked strips east of it. The reed work goes into the beds as the planting went into the strips: bundles come in green at the broken ends and pale grey at the frost-bitten tips, judged by the arm that carries them and never by a figure, a day's cutting a going-downriver and a coming-back at dusk, the cost asked in the form of a direction and answered with the weather or the river (T071/T072, T077, T058/T079). The yard still goes around the clean dark line and the new finer grey called the thaw, the space beneath the lowest rack, and the place in the strip where a hand went in and did not come back: a look, a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, not paid --- no name, cause, body, figure or payment). A woman come up from the strips asks what the reeds will cost now the hands are out of them and Sella glances once at the clay jar and sends her to the pot with Ask the pot what a wet thing costs set down there. The house has said it, as she sent a woman in Seed (T058/T079). The boy, one hundred and twenty-three days old and four months and three days, carried at the half-pace from every open slate, reads the going-around as a chart closed with a neat line over a note nobody opened --- exact, complete, worth nothing --- and sets it on a place of its own, laying no likeness across the shelf's two gaps, the fold's one crust or the empty place at his ear. Advances T098 (carried), T071/T072 (123), T009/T013/T092, T058/T079, T060/T086. Withheld: no name, no cause, no body, no figure, no third gap, no ending.

scenes.title: The House Will Keep It
scenes.synopsis: Second entry continued, Day 123, going of the light and the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof and at the loaf shelf. Sella gives the bucket, broom, pot and fire their instructions before anybody and never the basket, says the house where another woman would say I, goes wide around the space beneath the lowest rack as wide as a pail of hot water set where a child might knock it, and moves her lips along the loaf row without a figure. The shelf keeps its two unnamed gaps --- the old space at the row's end and the new palm's breadth from the night of Seed 6 --- in a room that does not touch the fold's one stiff brown-edged crust and its unnamed empty place, and no third comes (T060/T086, T097 carried and unpaid). At the fire she tells it it was the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, stands a moment counting under her breath toward no opening, pushes a strand of coal-black hair back with the wrist that carries the little-door burn (the grey streak pale), sets the pot where it can be found in the dark and does not look toward the bed (T058/T079). Tarn has taken the broom only after its instruction; the small bench knife lies at the very edge of its sill with six counted in a worn thumb-mark and the seventh nearly gone and still held, the unforged collector sentence beside it, his chest tight with the breath from Seed 16 still unspent and a small interval at the top of each reach (T036/T076). The boy turns out his file and finds six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and not paid, three intervals, the told bell beside the heard bell, the word forty unspoken, and the river's note on a place of its own (T061/T082). The three counts of river, fire and floorboards sit in three places and do not become one; the carried fire's fifth breath has no payer for a hundred and twenty-three days (T088). Advances T058/T079, T060/T086, T061/T082, T036/T076, T088, T071/T072 (123). Withheld: no calling of the loan, no spending of the seventh year, no joining of the two shelf gaps to the fold's gap, no seventh hearing, no ending.

scenes.title: The Bite Ahead of the Sentence
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and first \daymark of Day 124, Reed 5, Fifthday, before first grey through midday at the Vail wheel-shed and its finger's-width-open back room (not entered), the damper and the Clay Yard. Men unnamed come up the yard with their collars high and speak low in the back room; Jorra Vail gives the house no name for them and does not say the room was cold. He comes through with fine grey slate dust ground small as meal into both forearms past the bend of the little finger, not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel, keeps dusty forearms and clean ones on one tray, speaks to the wheel before anyone (It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady), tells a pot You'll do, knows its full note before it leaves the wheel and withholds it from a kiln-master come up from High Kiln who would call it early and make something of it (T035/T031). When Sella has not finished telling him the fire is low his bent finger goes into the cold iron of the damper ahead of her sentence, moves the tongue a hair's breadth and leaves it standing, and the household straightens around his silence the way cloth straightens when a weight is lifted. The boy reads the iron once more as the bite that holds a vessel whole and the bite that can take the hand off a man, with no word in Grathic for both mercies, and files it as an object worth nothing joined to no kiln (T062). Tarn takes the broom only after it has been given its instruction, says Yes, house to an early thaw and a late, keeps wanting the late because it puts off the paying, and presses his seventh year past the end of the third tend of the planting and still held: the knife at the very edge, six counted, the seventh where the house cannot check, the breath unspent, the unforged collector sentence kept beside it (T036/T076). His stroke goes on over the flagstones without the half-check, the stones keeping the shallow bright patch where it stopped, and neither man names the other's silence; the loan that can hear is uncalled. Advances T035/T031/T062, T036/T076, T071/T072 (124). Withheld: no name for the men, no calling of the loan, no spending of the seventh year, no joining of the two silences, no ending.

scenes.title: The Word at the Teeth
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry continued, Day 124, going of the light into the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof at the hearth and the kindling. With Sella at the fire and Jorra gone from the shed, Tarn has banked the coals and set the small knife where it can be checked, six in a worn thumb-mark and the seventh held; his chest is tight and the breath from Seed 16 is still unspent, the small interval at the top of each reach showing where it should have gone in. He speaks to the kindling and not to a person, and the sentence comes to the threshold of the word that would call the loan --- a thing about the ear under this roof being worth more than the debt that holds it, and what would follow if he said whose ear and set a figure to it --- and stops short of the word, with no figure given and no name spoken (T036/T076, first movement toward the calling of the loan, withheld). He draws the breath that should go in at the top of the reach and does not spend it, sets the knife where it can be checked, says Yes, house to the fire and goes on with the broom. Sella gives the end of her instruction to the pot and does not ask; Jorra does not ask about the ear and Tarn does not ask about the room; the two silences stay unjoined and the equality under the roof holds at the place it moved to. The boy files the stopped sentence on the interval tray beside Tarn's half-beat at the damper and the stroke that went on without the check, and beside his own held breath from the market --- an interval, not a payment, not a rule, not a seventh hearing (T061/T082). The kindling keeps four, four and an empty fifth. Something must give at the end of the seventh year and nothing has given yet. Advances T036/T076 (near-saying withheld), T061/T082, T058/T079, T060/T086, T035/T031/T062. Withheld: no calling of the loan, no figure for the near-saying, no name, no joining, no payment, no ending.

scenes.title: The Cord Goes Back Inside
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and first \daymark of Day 125, Reed 6, Sixthday, morning downriver at the Weir and the plank walk, then the stalls beyond the Cross and the out-of-line landing below the north bridge. The reed-cutter's tally is glimpsed again as a short length of wool or reed-fibre cord gone grey with handling, carried inside a man's coat and not counted, held on a place of its own beside Mira Silt's grey cord and the second twist beneath it, Orra Weir's knot-string lying beside Mira's board and not touching it, Alda Reed's six pages in the little tin and Dessa Silt's pewter tin above the abandoned bed (T099 carried, not paid, T059/T025/T024, T023/T089 --- no knot counted, no tin or box opened, no joining to the missing hand or to the word forty). Orra is at the Weir beside her board, gives a date instead of an answer to a question about the levy, watches what there is to watch and gets no answer from the basket; the word forty stays unspoken. Mira works the eels with slime dried in grey strokes on her sleeves, answers a question about the run with her own answer, moves eel-bones while deciding whether to lie and puts her thumb to the grey cord when a buyer names a figure; the second twist stays beneath it with neither knot counted, never carried upriver to Nine Pots or lifted at a door, and she does not look into the basket. At the landing the soft-cuffed clerk is still set with his cuff grey from washing and his slate to his forearm for a measure nobody called, hand to slate before eyes to stalls, and the market sells its reeds and eels over the top of him (T090/T080). Berr Clay comes up short from the clay road with the red cord folded under his coat and the green of tasted glaze at one corner of his mouth, wipes his thumb twice before touching nothing, says a number goes into a slate and not into a bundle, reads one in twelve as the notice says and takes himself out of his own sentence with your house, never I (T015/T041/T047/T077). The foundling is offstage: no loaf passed, no slate seen and no secret sold. Advances T099 (carried), T059/T025/T024, T090/T080, T083, T015/T041/T047/T077, T061/T082, T071/T072 (125). Withheld: no knot counted, no figure read, no sixth sighting of the neat dark hand, no loaf, no slate, no sale, no name from Dessa, no word forty, no joining of the records, no ending.

scenes.title: One Hundred and Twenty-Five
scenes.synopsis: Sixth entry continued, Day 125, going of the light and the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof. Sella has carried the boy up the clay road from the Weir at the half-pace from every open slate, gone around the space beneath the lowest rack as wide as a pail of hot water set where a child might knock it, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right at his ear and under his chin without once looking at his face and left the thread of drool frozen and unwiped; her hand rests a half-beat longer than the setting needed before it goes away. She tells the fire it was the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, stands a moment counting under her breath toward no opening, pushes a strand of coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, the grey streak pale, sets the pot rim out and handle toward the reaching hand where it can be found in the dark, does not look toward the bed and goes to her own bed (T058/T079). The door stands a finger's width open: the river's note of water over water comes through the gap, a sound kept on a place of its own since he was six days old, never a hearing and never among the six; through the floor under blind ash the carried fire takes its coal and gives back four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have been, its payer unnamed for a hundred and twenty-five days (T088); the boards overhead keep four nails, four, and a fifth that is a knot the width of a thumb. Three counts in three places; none becomes one. He turns out the file as a man lays instruments on a towel and finds six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and not paid, three intervals with Tarn's half-beat, the unchecking stroke and now the near-saying stopped at the threshold of the word on the same tray as objects and not a rule, the told bell beside the heard bell, the word forty unspoken, one stiff crust in the fold with its empty place unnamed and no third, the two shelf gaps in a room that does not touch, the cold foot below the sill still the cold to one woman and weather to the yard (T061/T082, T060/T086, T093/T094/T096, T036/T076). The hand that did not come back holds its place with no name or figure (T098), the reed-cutter's cord stays inside the coat with its knots unread (T099), and no finger of his joins any of them (T097). Nobody says he is one hundred and twenty-five days old; the count is exact and unspent and spoken by nobody, and goes on into Day 126. Advances T071/T072 (125), T061/T082, T060/T086, T093/T094/T096, T097, T098, T099, T088, T036/T076. Withheld: no joining, no payment, no name, no seventh hearing, no sixth sighting, no third gap, no word forty, no calling of the loan, no ending.
